script: "Neural Network" - peru ketka scary-a irukku, illa? Simple-a solluven. Ungal brain-la billions of neurons irukku. Oru neuron activate aana, aduthadhukku signal anuppum. Ungal brain-la 100 billion neurons irukku. Yaaru powerful? Aana brain electricity consume pannuradhu — 20 watts. GPT run pannuradhu — oru city-ku power supply mathiri electricity. Efficiency-la namba brain thaan winner. Ithu pathi innum kekkanum-na comment pannunga!
